turns.question: How many leads did every 100 euros of social ad spend get us in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no leads-per-100-euros metric, and I do not compute figures myself; the closest metric is Cost per lead (EUR), which for social ad campaigns over 1 to 30 September 2026 was 52.5 EUR per lead (2,100.0 EUR of social ad spend over 40 leads), the inverse view of your question. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
